description: Nutrient Processor + Data Extraction MCP: convert, OCR, sign, redact, and extract PDFs/Office docs.
name: io.github.PSPDFKit/nutrient-dws-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Nutrient DWS API key. Optional for local desktop use (browser sign-in on first request); required for CI or headless environments.
environmentVariables.name: NUTRIENT_DWS_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Data Extraction API key (starts with pdf_live_), needed for parse_document and extract_fields in static-key mode. OAuth covers both products.
environmentVariables.name: NUTRIENT_DWS_EXTRACTION_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Local directory the server is allowed to read and write documents in.
environmentVariables.name: SANDBOX_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Minimum logging level; defaults to info.
environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Log file path; defaults to a temporary file in stdio mode.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_FILE

title: Nutrient DWS MCP Server
